description: THE_NOVA_KNIGHTS is a student engineering and space-tech team led by Shaik Alinishar. United by a passion for human spaceflight and resilient software, we built ASTRA-MED—an offline-first, zero-trust 3D medical diagnostics OS grounded in NASA HRP research to keep Artemis and Mars crews safe during deep-space communication delays.
summary: ASTRA-MED (Autonomous Spaceflight Triage & Real-Time Astronaut Medical Diagnostics) is an offline-first, zero-trust 3D astronaut health monitoring OS built for Artemis lunar bases and Mars missions where Earth communication delays prevent live flight surgeon support. Aligned with the NASA Human Research Program (HRP) 5 Spaceflight Hazards and Canadian Space Agency (CSA) radiation guidelines, it combines an interactive Three.js 3D holographic anatomy HUD, browser-local webcam rPPG optical pulse scanning, a symptom-driven water/ration/Zero-G workout prescription engine, an offline AI Flight Surgeon with voice commands, xEMU EVA suit telemetry, and PBKDF2 + encrypted SQLite audit security. details:
What It Does & How It Works

ASTRA-MED (Autonomous Spaceflight Triage & Real-Time Astronaut Medical Diagnostics) is an offline-first, zero-trust 3D biomedical command center built for Artemis lunar bases and long-duration Mars missions where communication delays with Earth (up to 44 minutes round-trip) prevent real-time flight surgeon intervention.

Designed directly around the NASA Human Research Program (HRP) 5 Spaceflight Hazards (Space Radiation, Isolation & Confinement, Distance from Earth, Altered Gravity Fields, and Hostile Closed Environments) and Canadian Space Agency (CSA) radiation monitoring guidelines, ASTRA-MED enables astronauts to self-monitor and treat physiological risks autonomously through:

  • Interactive 3D Holographic Anatomy HUD (Three.js): A 60fps interactive 3D wireframe body with clickable organ and suit nodes (Brain & Neuro/SANS, Cardiovascular, Lungs & Cabin, Bone Density, and Radiation Shield) synchronized with color-coded Green/Amber/Red triage alerts and 7-Sol SVG telemetry trend sparklines.
  • Browser-Local Webcam rPPG Pulse & Fatigue Scanner: Uses local optical photoplethysmography (getUserMedia) to measure heart rate and blink fatigue directly on the spacecraft terminal with zero cloud video transmission.
  • Symptom-Driven Nutrition, Hydration & Zero-G Exercise Engine: Dynamically calculates daily hydration targets (mL/sol), space ration nutrients (Potassium, Calcium/Vitamin D3, Antioxidants), and ARED/T2/CEVIS countermeasure workouts based on active symptoms and mission environment (ISS, Lunar South Pole, Mars Transit, or Mars Surface).
  • Offline AI Flight Surgeon Co-Pilot & Voice Commands: Hands-free Web Speech voice navigation and plain-language clinical triage guidance for acute scenarios such as Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), dehydration, or Solar Particle Events.
  • xEMU EVA Suit Telemetry & 1-Click Emergency Trigger: Dedicated EVA suit thermal, battery, sublimator water, and cabin/suit $ppCO_2$ monitoring paired with a Red-Alert Emergency Distress Beacon.
  • Anti-Boredom Behavioral Health & Crew Readiness XP: Includes a 4-7-8 orbital breathwork pacer, Solar Shield reflex mini-game, cabin ambient sound synthesizer, and daily readiness streaks to combat isolation fatigue.

Tools, Languages & Architecture

  • Frontend: HTML5, CSS3 (Glassmorphism HUD), Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), Three.js (3D WebGL Hologram), Web Audio API, and Web Speech API.
  • Backend & Database: Zero-dependency Python (app.py) REST API with SQLite (WAL mode) and automatic air-gapped browser storage fallback.
  • Security & Governance: NASA-provisioned IAM authentication (Crew ID: NASA-ARTEMIS-04 | Passkey: ORION-2026), PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 / SHA-256 key derivation (100,000 iterations), sliding-window brute-force lockout, 15-minute idle auto-lock, encrypted biometric vault storage, and a tamper-evident SHA-256 hash-chained audit ledger. Released under the open-source MIT License with explicit educational/simulation medical disclaimers and zero PII storage.

Creativity, Impact & Design Factors Considered

Our team (THE_NOVA_KNIGHTS) prioritized cognitive clarity under high-stress emergencies, 100% offline resilience during deep-space comms blackouts, zero-trust medical data privacy, and unified preventive care—turning raw biometric numbers into clear water, food, and exercise actions. Beyond spaceflight, ASTRA-MED is directly adaptable for remote polar research stations, submarines, and offline rural telemedicine.
